description: OpenWolf auto-hooks — activated in settings.json. All hooks read stdin JSON from Claude Code.

PostToolUse.description: Reads stdin JSON, extracts file_path, appends to .wolf/.edit-log.jsonl. Tracked per session for /openwolf check.

Stop.description: Reads .wolf/.edit-log.jsonl, flags files edited ≥2 times, prints summary. Cleans up log for next session.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Reads stdin JSON, regex-matches user prompt for correction patterns (不对|错了|不要|wrong|broken|fix). Flags cerebrum Do-Not-Repeat.
